decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 8th June 2004, the matter described above is lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:

The existing garage and shed, being 5m and 2.57m deep by 3.4m and 1.58m wide respectively with a maximum flat roof height of 2.8m, that takes the total area of outbuilding coverage to approximately 12% of the dwellings curtilage, shown on the plans received on the 15th April 2004 constitutes permitted development as defined by Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (as amended) and therefore does not require planning permission.



Condition : 2 - INFORMATIVE 

The detached outbuildings hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse known as 30 Byward Avenue and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room or office development).
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the retention of an existing garage and shed to rear garden of existing dwellinghouse.
